newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end ahead, well supported.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end ahead, well supported.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Austrian bonds strengthened with Germany on Wednesday and traders said the market looked well supported at current levels.
"There is plenty of buying into the dips," said a trader, forecasting German bund futures would soon test the 102 level.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 40 bps at 101.00 to yield 5.73 (5.79) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.83/100.93 to yield 5.75/74.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 up 30 bps at 104.35 to yield 4.39 (4.47) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 104.10/104.20 to yield 4.45/43 percent.
* AGB future up 20 bps at 108.50 on turnover of 1,100 lots.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.333 and overnight money lower at 3.00/3.25.
